content: {"reasoning":"Authorization is missing, but the retroactive authorization window has closed; an appeal requires a denial, and peer-to-peer review is unavailable. Submit the initial claim with supporting records to document medical necessity and obtain an adjudication without assuming the records replace authorization. Billing the entire balance to the patient would exceed the stated contractual patient share, and writing off is premature before payer adjudication.","action":"submit_with_records"}
